title: Stock image search agent input
description: Input JSON for StockImageSearchConfig.from_json (theme + slides). Slide objects match slide records with title, content_text, image_url (e.g. tallest-buildings output items). Agent output mirrors this shape with each slide extended by an images array of stock hits; see output.schema.json. Unknown properties are ignored at runtime.

theme.description: Presentation or video theme used for LLM keyword context.

keyword_instructions.description: Optional extra guidance passed to the LLM when generating stock-photo search keywords for every slide.

slides.description: One entry per slide; same shape as a slide object in pipeline output (title, content_text, image_url).

title.description: Slide headline (e.g. building name and rank).

image_url.description: Existing image URL if any; often empty before search.
